create_MixUp_augmentation: create a MixUp instance with mixup_alpha and cutmix_alpha to apply mixup or cutmix augmentation to a batch
apply_mixup_cutmix_to_batch: apply mixup or cutmix data augmentation to a batch of images and labels using the MixUp callable
convert_targets_to_one_hot: convert class label indices to one-hot encoded tensors using convert_to_one_hot with label smoothing support
generate_cutmix_bbox: generate random bounding box coordinates for cutmix augmentation using get_cutmix_bbox with lambda correction
compute_mixup_target: compute the mixed target tensor with label smoothing using mixup_target given a lambda mixing coefficient
